product_categories_tenant_code_unique.name: product_categories_tenant_code_unique
product_categories_tenant_code_unique.where: "product_categories"."deleted_at" is null and "product_categories"."code" is not null

product_media_product_primary_unique.name: product_media_product_primary_unique
product_media_product_primary_unique.where: "product_media"."deleted_at" is null and "product_media"."product_sku_id" is null and "product_media"."is_primary" = true

product_media_sku_primary_unique.name: product_media_sku_primary_unique
product_media_sku_primary_unique.where: "product_media"."deleted_at" is null and "product_media"."product_sku_id" is not null and "product_media"."is_primary" = true

product_prices_branch_unique.name: product_prices_branch_unique
product_prices_branch_unique.where: "product_prices"."branch_id" is not null and "product_prices"."deleted_at" is null

product_skus_tenant_barcode_unique.name: product_skus_tenant_barcode_unique
product_skus_tenant_barcode_unique.where: "product_skus"."deleted_at" is null and "product_skus"."barcode" is not null

product_skus_reference_cost_check.name: product_skus_reference_cost_check
product_skus_reference_cost_check.value:
("product_skus"."reference_cost_amount" is null and "product_skus"."cost_currency" is null)
        or ("product_skus"."reference_cost_amount" >= 0 and "product_skus"."cost_currency" is not null)

order_items_product_reference_check.name: order_items_product_reference_check
order_items_product_reference_check.value:
(
        "order_items"."item_kind" = 'product'
        and "order_items"."product_sku_id" is not null
        and "order_items"."service_id" is null
        and "order_items"."ticket_id" is null
      ) or (
        "order_items"."item_kind" <> 'product'
        and "order_items"."product_sku_id" is null
        and "order_items"."product_price_id" is null
      )

payment_transactions_tenant_gateway_exte.name: payment_transactions_tenant_gateway_external_id_unique
payment_transactions_tenant_gateway_exte.where: "payment_transactions"."deleted_at" is null and "payment_transactions"."gateway" is not null and "payment_transactions"."gateway" <> '' and "payment_transactions"."external_id" is not null and "payment_transactions"."external_id" <> ''

delivery_tasks_active_appointment_unique.name: delivery_tasks_active_appointment_unique
delivery_tasks_active_appointment_unique.where: "delivery_tasks"."appointment_id" is not null and "delivery_tasks"."deleted_at" is null and "delivery_tasks"."status" <> 'cancelled'

inventory_balances_average_cost_check.name: inventory_balances_average_cost_check
inventory_balances_average_cost_check.value:
("inventory_balances"."average_unit_cost" is null and "inventory_balances"."currency" is null)
        or ("inventory_balances"."average_unit_cost" >= 0 and "inventory_balances"."currency" is not null)

inventory_movements_unit_cost_check.name: inventory_movements_unit_cost_check
inventory_movements_unit_cost_check.value:
("inventory_movements"."unit_cost" is null and "inventory_movements"."currency" is null)
        or ("inventory_movements"."unit_cost" >= 0 and "inventory_movements"."currency" is not null)
